title: Save all after a phone erase refuses each remaining report one by one instead of stopping the run: its stop rule does not check the record mark
evidence: Done by PR 1595 (6da0e36f9, commit 2a386b16d): LabReportSave.stop() now checks seen.mark.holds(at: store.mark) (LabReportSave.swift:207-208); pinned by LabSaveAllTests.testSaveAllStopsAfterAPhoneErase_US52_AC8b. Was: Raised by both reviews of PR 1540. ios/HealthRoadmap/LabUpload/LabReportSave.swift:203-207 stop() compares only the cloud erase and store.problem; on the phone both cloud erases are nil, so a phone erase passes. Each save is still refused by RecordStore+Uploads.swift:25 and :70 (seen.mark.holds), so nothing is written. Fix: add the same mark clause to stop(). Still open on main 9526525; no open PR matches LabReportSave. US-52 AC8b, US-25 AC11g
